title: ZTIE preprocessor routing-decision data contract (v1)
description: The derived routing DECISION produced by the Story 1.3 router for one intake artifact, and the shape allowed to cross the Forensic -> Hub boundary as a routing update (RD-013). A routing decision turns the class label (Story 1.2) into a PLAN OF WHICH CONTROLS TO APPLY: the set of downstream Phase-2 lanes the artifact enters, or the safe-reject entry (Story 1.4) when it is unroutable. Allow-list: additionalProperties false at every level; every field typed and enum/length-bounded. Integrity-keyed by intake_id + sha256 so a decision can only attach to the exact artifact it was computed over. DERIVED-ONLY: no raw body / base64 / executable content. ZERO-TRUST: a routing decision is a PLAN OF CONTROLS, never a safety verdict and NEVER a forward-to-PDE decision - there is no verdict/safe/approved/forward field; the verdict is Hub-side/human-gated (Phase 4). DECLARATIVE: lanes is a small closed set; other_unknown / an unroutable class routes to safe_reject (handed to Story 1.4), never into a scanner and never dropped.

contract_version.description: Routing-contract schema version. Pinned so the Hub validator rejects unknown-version envelopes fail-closed.

intake_id.description: The intake UUIDv4 this routing decision is for. The Hub upserts the decision onto the tracking record keyed by this.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the raw artifact body the decision was computed over. Integrity key, bound to intake_id; the Hub must reject a decision whose sha256 does not match the tracked record.

routed_at.description: RFC3339/ISO-8601 UTC timestamp (Z-suffixed) when the routing decision was made in Forensic.

routing.description: The derived routing decision: which lanes apply, and why. A PLAN OF CONTROLS only - never a verdict or a forward decision.

artifact_class.description: The class label this decision routed on (from the Story 1.2 classification). The routing table is a pure function of this.

lanes.description: The ordered, de-duplicated set of downstream lane targets this artifact is routed to. For a routable class this is one or more Phase-2 lanes (static_analysis and/or dynamic_detonation). For an unroutable class it is exactly [safe_reject] - handed to Story 1.4, never a scanner.

routable.description: True iff the class maps to one or more Phase-2 inspection lanes. False means the artifact is handed to the safe-reject entry (Story 1.4); lanes is then [safe_reject]. This is a routing fact, NOT a safety verdict.

basis.description: How the lane plan was derived. 'class_route' when the artifact_class matched a routing-table entry; 'safe_reject_fallback' when the class was other_unknown or an unrecognised class fell through to the safe-reject entry (fail-safe hand-off, never a crash).

notes.description: Optional short, bounded, non-executable diagnostic note (e.g. why the artifact was handed to safe-reject). Never raw content.
